name: Seoul Incheon International Airport
direct_access_note: First-hand browser access to the English site www.airport.kr/ap_en/: 6 pages captured on desktop and mobile (homepage 00:20 UTC; inner pages 10:59-11:02 UTC), 7 more read with Playwright, 3 interaction scripts (headers, skip links and keyboard, homepage flight search to results and detail, integrated search, mobile menu and flight list); every load returned HTTP 200 and no bot challenge appeared. An earlier probe in this project had received HTTP 502, so the fallback URL was not needed. Blocked by the container's network policy (not a site defect): icnmap.airport.kr:28702, so the Airport Map page was blank. Parking reservation, the duty-free operator site and the transfer route guide's output were not opened. Scores are expert assessments, not instrumented tests.

steps_to_flight_status_note: From the homepage: focus the 'Enter Flight number / Airline / City' field, type the number, press Flight Search; the results page shows the flight with status, counters and gate. One more click expands the route-to-gate detail.
axe_note: Homepage, axe-core WCAG A/AA rule violations (desktop 15 nodes, mobile 35). Departures: 5 rules / 138 nodes desktop (78 nested-interactive, 45 color-contrast), 4 rules / 101 nodes mobile. Mobility-impaired services: 3 rules / 21 nodes. meta-viewport (zoom disabled) fails on every page.

lighthouse_lab.note: lab, single container, hosts outside the allowlist blocked, indicative only

standouts.name: Route-to-gate flight detail
standouts.why: Shortest route from car park through tunnel and counters to the gate, walking time after immigration, destination time and weather, and sharing to KakaoTalk, LINE or e-mail.

standouts.name: Expected Airport Congestion forecast
standouts.why: Hourly passenger forecasts per arrival hall and departure area for the next two days, updated daily.

standouts.name: Real-time waiting times per departure area
standouts.why: Minutes and a four-level legend for every departure area in both terminals.

standouts.name: Power-user flight search
standouts.why: 20-day window with hour, destination, airline and flight-number filters, a Last Updated stamp and Excel download.

standouts.name: Facility-level site search
standouts.why: Answers with facilities (hours, exact location, view on map) rather than pages.

weaknesses: Weakest lab performance in the set: Lighthouse 27, LCP 25.1 s, TBT 2.4 s, departures TTFB 4.8 s; no security headers
Korean strings on English pages (some only for screen readers), no h1, zoom disabled, nested-interactive and contrast failures; 66 of 194 mobile targets under 24 px
Homepage clock and waiting-time stamp follow the visitor's device clock, not Korea time
Codeshares listed as separate rows; saved flights and alerts only in the app
Map depends on a non-standard port; search opens a new tab with no shareable URL; feedback needs login with Korean mobile verification; no chatbot on the English site
ideas: Merge the route-to-gate detail with live queue and walking times into one live 'time to gate' figure per flight
Turn congestion forecasts into advice, for example 'arrive by 07:10 for a 09:00 departure from Terminal 2'
Group codeshares under the operating flight while keeping every number searchable
Always show airport local time with its zone and timestamp every live figure from the data source
Offer web alerts by WhatsApp or push without an app or account
Set a performance budget (LCP under 2.5 s on mid-range mobile) and serve security headers by default
gaps: Map engine, parking reservation, duty-free site and the transfer route guide's output not observed
Only 'Departure' and 'Gate Closing' statuses were live during the captures
App features, AIRBOT and the generative-AI robots rest on search results; app ratings not checked
The waiting-time stamp's dependence on the device clock is inferred from one observation
Lighthouse and capture timings are lab values from one container
